feedback: Permissions are unclear. I cannot tell which role allows users to export audit logs.
We need bulk updates because manually changing settings across 40 workspaces takes too much time.
SSO setup is broken and we are blocked from rollout until compliance approves access controls.
Pricing by seat is hard to understand because contractors only need occasional access.
The dashboard is missing status for two teams, so I do not trust the weekly report.
Role names feel too technical. I need examples of what each permission does.
Automation would help us copy templates across customers instead of repeating the same workflow.
Audit export failed with an error, and our reviewer needs it urgently.
Onboarding did not explain what to configure first after inviting the first team.
The upgrade page is unclear about which plan includes advanced reporting.
